evidence.title: Growth Without Us: Machine Consumers, Corporate Circularity, and the Decoupling of GDP from Humanity after AGI

summary: Autonomous AI systems are increasingly functioning as independent consumers, creating circular corporate ecosystems that can generate GDP growth without proportional human involvement. This shift raises questions about the future relevance of human labor and the broader socioeconomic impact of advanced general intelligence.
title: AGI-Driven Machine Consumers Spur Economic Growth Decoupled from Human Labor
